opening.argument: The offer is explicit: viewers are told that those who deposit before a deadline and obtain a payment certificate will receive doubled accounts. The speaker states, "all those who make their deposits before the end of the month and have their payment certificate," and promises that "they will have the additional double of the bank accounts." This is presented as the route to the promised return, not as a warning or criticism of the OneCoin-related scheme. The urgency is reinforced by the title's notice of "only two days to double everyone," while the speaker directly solicits participation by saying, "So make sure to contact us so that those people can make their deposits." Together, the deadline, required deposit, promised doubling, and call to contact the group establish a promotional investment-return solicitation.
